name: The St. Regis Abu Dhabi
insider_take: Where Arabian elegance meets modern luxury on the pristine shores of the Nation Riviera Beach Club.
whats_special: The St. Regis Abu Dhabi stands as the only beachfront St. Regis in the Middle East, featuring the brand's legendary Butler Service and positioned directly on the Corniche with unobstructed views of the Arabian Gulf. The hotel's signature afternoon tea ritual takes place in the stunning Nation Riviera Beach Club, while the property houses the city's highest rooftop bar offering 360-degree panoramic views.
pro_tip: Book a Corniche-facing room on higher floors for spectacular sunrise views over the Gulf, and don't miss the St. Regis Butler drawing you a bath with their signature bath salts while you enjoy champagne on your private balcony.
dont_miss: The world-renowned Nation Riviera Beach Club with its infinity pools cascading toward the Gulf, and Villa Toscana restaurant featuring authentic Italian cuisine with waterfront dining. Take advantage of the hotel's prime location for morning jogs along the Corniche promenade, one of Abu Dhabi's most scenic waterfront stretches.
pros: Legendary St. Regis butler service available 24/7
Prime location on the Corniche with stunning Arabian Gulf views
World-class spa and wellness facilities with traditional treatments
Multiple award-winning restaurants featuring international cuisine
Luxurious beachfront access with private beach club amenities
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Formal atmosphere may not suit all vacation styles
